Connetic now routes Swift ledger txns
Positions ACI in emerging tokenized deposit flows; potential new demand from banks.
Reduces parallel ops for banks, lowering friction to adopt ACI’s hub.
Value prop: balance speed/cost/availability across rails; stickier clients.
Supports production volumes as pilots move to scale; upsell potential.
Swift ledger in initial use, 17 banks
Early ecosystem traction increases relevance of ACI’s integration.

This is an early-stage strategic move to align ACI’s hub with Swift’s tokenized deposit ledger as pilots expand. A larger catalyst would be named bank adoptions, revenue contributions, or ARR wins tied to Swift ledger processing.
